title: sealed modular drive mechanisms and servo service parts

specimens.name: Sealed precision servo cartridge
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE compact sealed servo motor cartridge, smooth off-white cylindrical body with flat square mounting flange and one short output shaft, subtle service connector. Motor only; no gearbox, no exposed fins or wires.

specimens.name: Inline planetary reducer module
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE short stand-alone compact precision planetary reduction gearbox, squat graphite-and-metal barrel with circular mounting flange, one short output shaft and small input coupling socket. No attached motor or encoder.

specimens.name: Electromechanical linear actuator
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE compact electric linear actuator with an enclosed rectangular motor body and a short straight guarded rod protruding through a protective sleeve. No external hydraulic hoses, no mounting frame or long rail.

specimens.name: Enclosed belt-drive cassette
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE short flattened rectangular enclosed drive cassette with a small open cutaway exposing one continuous toothed belt loop around exactly two pulleys, practical bearing supports and a short input shaft. No external motor or long transport mechanism.

specimens.name: Brake-clutch shaft cartridge
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE short circular mechanical brake/clutch cartridge with a single central through shaft and a small square inspection port in its side. Indicate stacked friction plates within the port; no motor or gear teeth.

specimens.name: Servo encoder rear endcap
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE shallow flat disc-shaped servo feedback encoder endcap with a recessed keyed feedback connector on its edge and three small mounting holes. Show the back cap only: no motor body or shaft, no separate plugs.

specimens.name: Rotary actuator output yoke
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE compact forked rotary actuator output yoke on a central rotating circular collar and a stationary mounting ring. The ROTATING collar has ONE unmistakable solid radial metal stop-lug projecting OUTWARD from its edge. The STATIONARY ring carries TWO fixed raised metal stop-blocks on opposite sides of that moving lug, spaced along the arc. Show the moving lug physically TOUCHING one fixed stop-block, while the other block remains clearly separated on the other side; it must be obvious that the lug strikes either stop as the yoke turns and limits rotation. Same physical assembly, no extra loose pieces, no linear rod, no whole actuator.

specimens.name: Servo thermal jacket
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE hollow cylindrical split cooling jacket sleeve for fitting around a servo motor, with two small coolant inlet/outlet ports on one side and a visible internal annular coolant passage in a small cutaway. No motor inside, no hoses, no shaft.

era_contract.character: E3 2015 modular spaceport precision mechanics: compact serviceable sealed cartridges, protected motion, physically plausible interfaces and cooling, manufactured off-white aluminium and graphite housings. HD pixel-art game art, not a photographic industrial catalog.
required_signals: eight physically distinct mechanisms, clearly isolated and shown large in the assigned cell
sealed motor, reducer, protected linear actuator and enclosed belt drive convey different mechanical functions
brake, encoder endcap, rotary yoke and coolant jacket are visibly distinct partial service components, not repeated complete motors
real shafts, mounts, clear fluid port function and readable mechanical stops where specified
quiet modern modular construction with upper-left lighting and exact style bible
Edit the supplied source sheet: preserve the appearance, positions and style of the other seven cells; correct only cell 7 to show a rotating lug touching one of two fixed mechanical stop blocks.
